decision: No lobe surface admission: the five PART-OF compounds contain only source-labelled airway and vessel files, not independently delineated lobe parenchyma or fissures.
method: Pinned source-table memberships, raw OBJ SHA-256, smallest explicit source labels, exact-coordinate diagnostic topology. No geometry edits, clinical approval or inferred tissue envelope.
